newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Electron files $1 bln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Electron files $1 bln shelf offer.

text.p: Thermo Electron Corp on Friday said it registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a shelf offering of up to $1 billion of stock or debt securities.
Earlier Friday, two companies in which Thermo Electron holds a controlling interest -- Thermedics Inc and Thermo Instrument Systems Inc -- filed for a shelf offerings of up to $250 million each.

"We have absolutely no intention of doing an offering," said Thermo Electron's chief financial officer John Hatsopoulos in an interview. "We'd be crazy to do an offering now, with the share prices of the companies so low."
He added a debt offering was out of the question too, as the diversified engineering company has plenty of cash.

Hatsopoulos said the company decided to file now because it wants to do future offerings as discreetly as possible. He added Thermo is filing for about 20 subsidiaries that qualify for debt or stock offerings.
